control.description-key: Displays numeric or currency fields as written-out words. Auto-detects Greek or English from the user UI language. By DYFIA.

property.name: value
property.description-key: The numeric or currency field to convert

property.name: currencyCode
property.description-key: ISO currency code: EUR, USD, GBP, CHF. Leave empty for plain numbers without currency label.

property.name: defaultLanguage
property.description-key: Fallback language when user language is not Greek or English. Use: el-GR or en-US

property.name: capitalize
property.description-key: Capitalize the first letter of the output

property.name: wordsOutput
property.description-key: Optional: bind to a text column to save the words back to Dataverse (available in views and flows)
